reason: The existing mapping to Article 14 only covers the requirement to have crisis communication plans. The control objective also requires including these plans in ICT business continuity testing. Article 11(6)(b) explicitly mandates testing the crisis communication plans established under Article 14, which is a material part of the control objective not covered by the existing mapping.
